<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Tough to Kill](/Classes.aspx?ID=67)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 37

**Class** Guardian
</column>

---

The protectiveness of your armor ensures that even if you fall, you take longer to die. You gain the [Diehard](/Feats.aspx?ID=5140) general feat. If you already have the Diehard feat, you can retrain it when you get tough to kill. Additionally, the first time each day you’d be reduced to [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) 3 or higher, you stay at dying 2 instead.
name: Tough to Kill
